properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): add_decision draws exploratory `related_to` through the core review_relations and THROWS AWAY its outcome, the very subject-first sentences the brainstorm skill promises, so the reply names no edge for any kind; for a choice or no-kind decision it also draws nothing (the 2026-09-23 drop, still live on 0.72.0). Class: each constructor hand-builds its reply, and 2 of the 5 that draw edges inline (add_decision, add_capability) echo none
properties.statement:
① OBSERVED (dev_storyflow agent, 2026-09-27 evening, flo2.io hosted engine, reflow2 0.72.0; art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27, verbatim): "`add_decision` with `related_to` does not echo the edges it drew. The brainstorm skill says replies echo each edge as a subject-first sentence so a reversed direction shows. I passed `incoming: true` twice and could not confirm the direction from the reply." Wish #52: "`add_decision … related_to` echoes each drawn edge as a subject-first sentence, like the brainstorm skill promises." Expected: the brainstorm skill's step 4, added by #555 on 2026-09-20: "the reply now echoes each edge as a sentence with its subject first". NOT affected: review_relations, which does echo.

② PRECEDENT. fact:related-to-on-a-choice-passes-the-duplicate-guard-and-is-then-dropped-2026-09-23: related_to is drawn only for kind=exploratory. It is still open, and its ⑥ already noted "the reply echoes the node, not the relations". dec:idea-a-relation-offered-on-any-decision-is-drawn-or-said-to-be-ignored option (d), "EVERY CONSTRUCTOR ECHOES THE RELATIONS IT DREW", is still proposed. The echo itself is chg:a-drawn-relation-is-read-back-as-a-sentence (#555) / this capability (realized), pinned by ver:the-two-directions-of-a-drawn-relation-do-not-read-alike, a CORE-level test only (crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_drawn_relation_is_read_back_as_a_sentence.rs). Nothing records the discard on the exploratory path. So the non-exploratory half is a RECURRENCE (measured below), and the exploratory half is NEW.

③ CANDIDATES. (a) The reporter's decision was not exploratory, so related_to was dropped entirely (the 09-23 defect) and there was nothing to echo. (b) The exploratory path draws through the core review_relations, and the add_decision handler discards the returned ReviewOutcome, whose drawn/already_present hold the sentences, then replies with the node only. (c) Not in reflow2: flo2 runs a different build, or its gateway strips reply fields. (d) Intent/contract bone: the skill's promise was written for review_relations and read as covering add_decision's related_to; add_decision's own relatedness refusal sends callers to related_to "in this same call". (e) The observation is wrong: the echo was in the reply and was missed or truncated.

④ DISCRIMINATOR. Call add_decision (exploratory) with two related_to links, one incoming:true, on the published binary with no gateway, and read every key of the reply. Then re-send the same links to review_relations, which reports existing edges as already_present sentences, to learn whether they were drawn and which way round. (b) predicts edges present, direction correct, no edge field in the reply. (e) predicts an edge field present. (c) predicts the local binary echoes. (a) predicts no edges for exploratory either. Separately, choice and no-kind should show no edges if the precedent still holds.

⑤ RESULT (v0.72.0 binary, scratch store; capture.rs and relate.rs byte-identical v0.72.0 to HEAD 0beb693):
  exploratory + related_to [EVOLVES_INTO dec:idea-older-thought incoming:true; DEPENDS_ON dec:idea-prereq]: reply keys exactly [graph_id, loop_hint, node_id, node_type, properties], no edge named. review_relations with the same links: drawn [], already_present ["dec:idea-older-thought EVOLVES_INTO dec:idea-new-exploratory", "dec:idea-new-exploratory DEPENDS_ON dec:idea-prereq"]. Both were drawn, and incoming was honoured.
  kind=choice + related_to, and kind omitted + related_to: same reply keys. review_relations then DREW the edges fresh, so add_decision had drawn nothing. The 09-23 defect RECURS on 0.72.0 and the current source.
  export_graph confirmed the edge list.
  REPRODUCED BY THE TRIAGE ITSELF on the live dev_reflow2 hub server: add_decision dec:idea-a-cross-type-near-match-is-a-note-and-only-a-same-type-one-refuses (exploratory, three related_to, one incoming) replied with the node and search_first and no edge. review_relations then returned all three as already_present sentences, direction correct.
  So (e) is refuted: there is no field to miss. (c) is not needed: the symptom reproduces with no gateway (flo2's build was not checked independently). (b) is confirmed. (a) cannot be told apart from (b) by the reply, since both are silent. Storyflow's design, read-only, holds 09-27 ideas that are kind: exploratory and carry relations (relation_candidates.already_related on dec:idea-llm-work-with-no-chat-present and dec:idea-media-generation-through-the-users-chat-connector). That is consistent with (b) for the reporter.
  CODE: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs ~2935, `g.review_relations(node_ty, &req.id, &links, …).map_err(dyno_err)?;`. The Ok(ReviewOutcome) is dropped, and has been since #394 (7954829, 2026-08-30), before the sentence existed. #555 (7945948) made the core label a sentence and wrote the promise into the skill. The MCP review_relations handler returns the outcome via ok_json; add_decision's handler does not, and no MCP-level test asserts add_decision's reply.

⑥ CLASS. The sentence is rendered ONCE (core ReviewOutcome, relate.rs) and shared by both callers, but SURFACING it is left to each handler. Each constructor hand-builds its reply, with no shared "edges this call drew" block and no stated invariant that every edge a call draws is named in its reply. Measured on 0.72.0, five constructors draw edges inline:
  add_verification echoes `verifies: [ids]`
  add_change_event echoes `changed`
  record_finding echoes `subject` and `caused_by`
  add_capability builds a `drawn` list (capture.rs ~1863-1874) and DISCARDS it: SATISFIES and ALLOCATED_TO drawn, reply silent
  add_decision discards the ReviewOutcome
So 3 of 5 echo (ids, not sentences), 2 of 5 echo nothing, and 0 of 5 render the subject-first sentence. The only constructor with a caller-chosen direction (`incoming`) is one of the two silent ones. The unstated invariant is the same one the 09-23 drop broke: every declared target is an edge after the call, and the reply says so. Would fixing add_decision alone close the class? No: add_capability has the same shape.

⑦ PIN (not written; out of scope for this triage). An MCP-level test over every constructor that takes relation targets (satisfies, allocated_to, related_to for EVERY kind, verifies, affected, caused_by): diff the edge set before and after the call, and assert that the reply names each new edge as a `{from} {RELATION} {to}` sentence and names nothing that is not a new edge. It fails today on add_decision (every kind) and add_capability. On choice and no-kind the diff is empty although targets were offered.

⑧ PROPOSED FIX. This is the reporter's wish #52, recorded as this finding's fix rather than as a new idea, because the root cause covers it fully and dec:idea-a-relation-offered-on-any-decision-is-drawn-or-said-to-be-ignored option (d) already holds the broader question. Return the ReviewOutcome's drawn/already_present from add_decision, and add_capability's drawn edges, in the reply. Better still, have every constructor report the edges it drew through one shared reply helper.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED. Whether the reporter's two decisions were exploratory: their session is not visible, and storyflow's exploratory 09-27 ideas are consistent with that but do not identify the calls. Whether their incoming edges landed the right way round (already_related is direction-blind). flo2's exact build, taken from the report. (Established afterwards: the hub server used for the in-session reproduction reports reflow2_version 0.72.0, from loop_status.served_by.)

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS. "add_decision with related_to does not echo the edges it drew" is CONFIRMED, for every kind, on 0.72.0 and the current source. Sharpened: for a choice or no-kind decision it did not draw them either, so the silent reply there hides a DROP, not only a direction. "The brainstorm skill says replies echo each edge": the sentence is true only of review_relations. Read in context, the skill promises something add_decision has never done.

⑩ STILL LIVE ON 0.74.0 — reproduced 2026-09-28 in a dev_reflow2 hub session writing to three designs (graph-primitives and storyflow on the flo2-hosted engine, loop_status.served_by reflow2_version 0.74.0; and this design, local 0.74.0). Not a new cause, a version datapoint, so no fix should be assumed from the version bump alone.
  kind=choice + related_to (3 links, one incoming): propagate_from from the new decision reached nothing, and review_relations with the same links then DREW all three fresh — so add_decision drew none. Same as ⑤.
  kind=exploratory + related_to (5 decisions, 1–3 links each): reply named no edge; review_relations afterwards returned each as already_present, direction correct. Same as ⑤.
  add_capability + satisfies (26 capabilities across the three designs): every reply silent on SATISFIES; propagate_from(depth 1) from 8 of the requirements showed all 8 SATISFIES edges present. So add_capability draws and does not echo, as ⑥ says.
  The workaround a session actually uses — a follow-up review_relations or propagate_from after every constructor call, to learn what it drew — cost roughly one extra call per constructor call in that session.

RECURRED 2026-09-29 on 0.74.0 (art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item I16). A designer agent working the flo2 design "ideal knowledge graph" through the claude.ai connector recorded 7 kind=choice decisions with related_to. They landed with no edges, and the first detect_gaps raised unreviewed_ideas on all 7; the workaround was 7 review_relations calls. REPRODUCED the same day in an isolated scratch graph with the installed 0.74.0 release binary (--call add_decision, kind=choice, one DEPENDS_ON in related_to): the reply carried no edge and no warning, and the export held 0 edges on the new decision. The class and cause above stand unchanged. The pinning test and the fix are still owed.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #623 (squash 449ba2b). Its change record, chg:add-decision-draws-related-to-for-every-kind-and-every-constructor-names-its-edges, is in the committed design (main's export), not in this live store.

Verified in the merged code:
- add_decision draws related_to for every kind; the exploratory scope was removed.
- add_decision and add_capability, like add_verification, add_change_event and record_finding, report every drawn edge through one shared module, crates/reflow2-mcp/src/drawn_edges.rs (DrawnEdges::from_review).
- It is pinned by crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_constructor_names_every_edge_it_drew.rs, observed failing first on origin/main.

The live server still runs 0.74.0, so the behaviour is not yet observable here.
